description: Reviewed blank-fill metadata. MAD always wins. Resolution describes the native scan class, not optional scaling or every supported output mode. No automatic inference from MAME raster dimensions.

groups.evidence: X Board raw screen clock 50 MHz / 8, 400 clocks per line: 15.625 kHz. Applies only to these reviewed mainline sets.
Core README explicitly describes native 15 kHz with scandoubling off. MAME: 42.954545 MHz / 6 / 454 = 15.77 kHz.
Native CRTC timing: 9.828 MHz / 2 / 312 = 15.75 kHz. Hardware-source provisional value; optional FPGA output modes are not asserted.
Raw screen timing: 14.318181 MHz / 2 / 456 = 15.70 kHz. PCB sync measurements in the same driver corroborate this.

CPS3 native H sync is approximately 15.734 kHz. cps3_jojo names Light, Medium, Strong and Stand; the generic six-button port definition also includes unused inputs, so the listxml count is not the action count.
Left/right are physical buttons, plus the two action inputs. Do not describe the cabinet as an 8-way joystick. Resolution remains unspecified: this vector core supports multiple raster scan classes.
